title.narrative: Building LCN institutional capacity for effective and constructive engagement in development and governance

description.narrative: The Outcome (Specific Objective) of this project is the ''Enhanced capacity of Lesotho Council of NGOs (LCN) to coordinate Civil Society as a whole in Lesotho and increased ability of its members to deliver their mandates''. This intervention is expected to achieve the following five (5) results:- ¿Enhanced coordination of LCN for effective engagement with duty bearers and legitimate representation of civil society voice as a whole in Lesotho; ¿Increased promotion, awareness raising and coordination on gender sensitivity, leadership skills, governance expertise and accountability within CSO community; ¿Improved mechanisms for dialogue on Policy and Political Reforms and Nation Building in Lesotho; ¿MoU between GoL and LCN governing civil society operations negotiated and agreed; ¿LCN and its members contribute to, analyse, track and ensure gender sensitiveness of the National Budget.

title.narrative: Number of LCN members in good standing attending NGO Week Dialogues

description.narrative: In order to achieve this indicator, the following criteria has to met; a member is categorized by full membership and associate. This is differentiated by amount of subscription paid by each category. NGO Week is held on annual basis as a platform where civil society organisations gather together for the whole week with the purpose of sharing and reflecting on the progress and challenges facing development in the context of NGO operations in Lesotho and vouch for possible solutions and way forward. The civil society organisations are able to take part in seminars, discussions and debates on issues of national importance.
